description: Implementation of the SHA-256 hashing algorithm, including functions for initialization, updating, transformation, and finalization of hash computation.

methods.name: sha256_transform
methods.description: Performs the core SHA-256 transformation on a data block.

methods.name: sha256_init

methods.name: sha256_final
